name: Anthony Wint
summary: A former FIU linebacker (a season in the NFL) with high-school wrestling: 8-0, running through opponents on horsepower. Undersized for heavyweight; fighting for the second time in about seven weeks.

how_they_fight.Striking: Explosive power; wins by overwhelming opponents early.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Wrestling base; submitted Terrance Chatman in round one in his UFC debut.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Hasn't had to overcome adversity yet.

keys_to_beat: Survive the storm and hit him as he comes in

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
